issues.location: tautology value under a named many-valued logic
issues.finding: The preceding satisfaction definition indexes the formula value by the logic L, but the tautology condition immediately drops [L] from pValue while retaining L on entailment. In many-valued semantics the value depends on the logic's chosen truth functions.
issues.proposed_resolution: Write pValue_v(A)[L] in the target tautology condition, consistent with the immediately preceding satisfaction condition.

translation_treatment: The target translates the classical baseline, multiple truth values, logic-specific truth functions and designated values, with the tautology value indexed by the named logic. Frozen source is unchanged.
